name: Endless Labyrinth of Night Roads
source:
Join the slice of life, coming of age story about the wolf travelling across the world of impressionistic landscapes.

ELoNR is a short, visual-heavy VN centring on the relationships between our main lead Jeremie and various folks from his life. Jeremy is a drifter, a delivery man who can travel the world through the network of portals. From lonely peaks to bustling valleys, he has seen it all, but every wanderer will inevitably wander home.

[Edited from [url=https://nik-rouz.itch.io/endless-labyrinth-of-night-roads]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入关于狼穿越印象派风景世界的生活片段和成长故事。

ELoNR是一部简短、视觉效果丰富的视频，以我们的主角杰里米 (Jeremie) 和他生活中的各种人之间的关系为中心。杰里米是一名漂泊者，一名可以通过门户网络环游世界的送货员。从寂寥的山峰到繁华的山谷，他都看过了，但每个游子都难免会徘徊回家。

[编辑自[url=https://nik-rouz.itch.io/endless-labyrinth-of-night-roads]Itch.io[/url]]
